blind.B1: No for an exercise question. The 6 sequenced GAS samples (3 MI4KO, 3 MI4OE) differ only by IRF4 genotype; RNA-seq was not done on exercised animals (S4.17.p1, S2.5.p1). Exercise effects in the paper are qPCR/western only (S2.1.p1, Fig 1). No sequenced sample carries an exercise factor. At most this is a genotype study of an exercise-capacity gene.
blind.B2: GAS: MI4OE vs MI4KO, n=3 vs 3 (S2.5.p1, S4.17.p1, Fig 5a); results normalized to MI4KO; 872 DEGs, 312 up / 560 down.
blind.B3: None. Independent mice; one muscle per sample in this series. Packet A lists no candidate pairing key. (Mouse 1283 also appears in GSE140633 as a different muscle, but that is a different series.)
blind.B4: Paper does not say joint or pairwise; only 2 groups, so moot. Method: edgeR with TMM on RSEM output (S4.17.p1).
blind.B5: 'Differentially expressed genes were identified using the edgeR program, as defined by having a fold change of at least 1.5 and a p-value of <0.05' (S4.17.p1); S2.5.p1 '|fold-change| of >=1.5 and a p-value of <0.05'; Fig 5b legend 'p < 0.05 and log FC > 0.58'. Raw p, not FDR. Counts: 872 (312 up, 560 down) in GAS; 447 in SOL.

checks.evidence: No exercise arm in the sequenced samples (S4.17.p1, S2.5.p1; packet A: no exercise words in any column). Refusal at design matches B1.
grp MKO 3 / MOE 3 matches S4.17.p1 and GEO genotype column; no exclusions.
No contrast was run. The planned MI4OE vs MI4KO matches the paper (S2.5.p1).
No repeated measures in this series; packet A has no candidate keys.
All male, one muscle. GEO says high fat diet while the paper's phenotyping is on chow; recorded in paper_data_discrepancies.
rsem_count file is RSEM expected counts (84% integer), matches paper's edgeR input; noted that rounding would be needed.
paper_threshold p<0.05 raw, |log2FC|>=0.585, matches B5. Deposited table gives 1547 vs paper 872; recorded in HANDBACK.
No own DE counts; HANDBACK cites the paper's 872 for MI4OE vs MI4KO and says it does not claim a match.
'No exercise arm' is supported by metadata (all columns), the paper's RNA-seq methods and results. Search was wide (metadata, methods, results, figure legends).

human_items: Policy question (open): whether a genotype contrast on an exercise-capacity gene (MI4OE vs MI4KO) should be run as a labelled non-exercise result. Currently refused; consistent with the skill rule.
summary: 该系列的 RNA-seq 只比较 IRF4 基因型(MI4OE vs MI4KO),没有任何运动处理组,运动效应在论文中仅由 qPCR/western 测得。拒绝运行的理由成立且检查范围足够。阈值、n、方法转录均与论文一致。
